facts.shortSummary: The party investigates a recently abandoned campsite outside the ruined Dunmari fort and follows its owner's tracks toward the causeway.
facts.longSummary: After reviewing their earlier fight with hobgoblin skeletons, the party examines the foundations outside the fort. They find a concealed, human-sized campsite with scattered food, a shovel, and gear left behind but no weapons or water. Tracks connect the camp to the disturbed burial mound and lead into the fort without returning, suggesting that the missing camper entered prepared for danger and never came back.

location.context: outbuilding foundations and abandoned campsite outside the causeway
location.notes: The party remains outside the fort walls while investigating the campsite and tracks.

npcs.name: Arcus
npcs.notes: The transcript does not yet identify the camper by name; the later-established identity is Arcus.

facts.shortSummary: An ankheg erupts beneath Wellby during his reconnaissance of the fort, but the party frees him and kills the creature.
facts.longSummary: Wellby crosses the causeway alone and scouts the ruined headquarters, cistern, towers, and pentagonal building while a large chittering creature moves inside the central ruin. As the others approach, Delwath recognizes the signs of a burrowing desert predator, but an ankheg bursts from below and seizes Wellby. Seeker undermines its rear legs with Mold Earth, Kenzo strikes its mandibles until it releases Wellby, and Delwath delivers the killing blow with his longsword.

location.context: causeway, courtyard, and ruined central headquarters
location.notes: The ambush occurs beside the central ruin after Wellby's reconnaissance.

npcs.name: Ankheg
npcs.notes: It seizes Wellby and is killed by the party.

mainEnemies.name: Ankheg
mainEnemies.notes: A giant burrowing insect that ambushes and grapples Wellby.

combat.notes: The complete ankheg fight occurs within this beat.

facts.shortSummary: The party examines the ankheg's lair, discovers extensive animal traffic into the caves, and chooses to rest in the pentagonal building.
facts.longSummary: The party confirms that the ankheg was behaving with unusual daytime aggression, then searches the ruined headquarters where it had been feeding on a lion. A sloping natural passage beneath the ruin contains signs of lions, hyenas, lizards, and other creatures moving in both directions. With the air still and the hour just after lunchtime, the party postpones entering the caves and heads toward the intact pentagonal building for shelter and a short rest.

location.context: ruined central headquarters and entrance to the ankheg's burrow
location.notes: The party inspects the underground entrance but does not descend.

npcs.name: Ankheg
npcs.notes: Its lair and abnormal aggression are investigated after the battle.

facts.shortSummary: The party rests in the magically preserved Dunmari temple, recovers sacred objects, and finds an enchanted horn in a ruined tower.
facts.longSummary: The pentagonal building proves to be a temple to the Five Siblings whose enchanted walls have survived the fort's destruction. The party identifies and takes Aagir's Everlight, gathers portable religious relics, and completes a short rest in the temple's calming atmosphere. Searching the gate towers afterward, Wellby finds the old remains of a Dunmari scout or outrider and recovers a magical horn decorated with a running-horse motif before the party prepares to descend underground.

location.notes: The party moves among structures within the fort but remains in the same larger location.

items.name: Aagir's Everlight
items.notes: A silver spearpoint statuette whose tip burns with an unconsuming flame.

items.name: Recovered Dunmari temple relics
items.notes: Portable chalices, amulets, candlesticks, and other sacred objects gathered for return to town.

items.name: Horn of Silent Alarm (Dunmari)
items.notes: A magical ram's horn with silver filigree in a running-horse design, found with an old Dunmari scout.

organizations.name: Dunmari Religion
organizations.notes: The intact temple is dedicated to the Five Siblings.

facts.shortSummary: Underground, the party finds the petrified Arcus and a Chardonian coin that transforms into a floating disc.
facts.longSummary: The party descends through the ankheg's tunnel into a junction where they find an extraordinarily lifelike stone man missing one arm, with a broken stone torch nearby. The recent condition of the statue and its waterskin connect it to the abandoned campsite, although the party does not yet know Arcus's name. A heavy old Chardonian coin lying nearby radiates transmutation magic; when Seeker flips it, it unfolds into a hovering disc that follows him and can carry weight before returning to coin form.

location.context: underground junction beneath the central headquarters
location.notes: Two passages branch southward from the chamber containing Arcus.

npcs.name: Arcus
npcs.notes: The party links the recent stone figure to the missing camper but does not identify him by name during the session.

items.name: Floating Disc Coin
items.notes: An unusually heavy Chardonian coin that becomes a hovering disc when flipped.

facts.shortSummary: The party discovers a cockatrice nursery where hatchlings repeatedly petrify a trapped lion, then retreats to explore the other tunnel.
facts.longSummary: Following the narrower branch, the party reaches a muddy chamber containing cockatrice hatchlings, eggs, and a lion that repeatedly turns to stone and back as the hatchlings peck it. They watch unseen long enough to identify the creatures and consider whether the cockatrices also petrified Arcus. Unwilling to provoke the hatchlings or risk meeting their parents while Seeker is low on magic, they withdraw to the junction and choose the wider passage toward the detected obsidian.

location.context: cockatrice nursery in the narrower southeastern tunnel
location.notes: The muddy chamber contains eggs, hatchlings, and a repeatedly petrified lion.

npcs.name: Cockatrice hatchlings
npcs.notes: The hatchlings peck the lion and repeatedly turn it to stone.

npcs.name: Lion
npcs.notes: It repeatedly returns to flesh, kills one hatchling, and is petrified again.

facts.shortSummary: The wider tunnel leads beneath the ruined cistern, where the party follows the old watercourse toward the source of the disturbance.
facts.longSummary: The party retreats to the statue chamber and follows the wider branch into a cavern beneath the cracked cistern, where midafternoon light shines through the collapsed floor. After a brief pause, they continue south along the dry watercourse while debating whether the fort's geological damage, altered animals, and detected obsidian share a magical source. They conclude that Arcus may have been another investigator rather than the cause and press cautiously toward a larger cavern.

location.context: cavern beneath the ruined cistern and the southbound watercourse
location.notes: The party follows the wider underground branch toward the obsidian signal.

items.name: Obsidian artifact
items.notes: A detected but unseen concentration of obsidian guides the party farther south.

facts.shortSummary: A wave of unnatural rage and three animated skeletons confront the party at the entrance to the southern cavern.
facts.longSummary: As Delwath reaches the cavern entrance, an unseen influence briefly freezes him and three skeletons drop from the ceiling to attack. Delwath recognizes that the source of the animals' rage is nearby, then holds the narrow front while the others fight from behind him. He destroys one skeleton with a Hex-enhanced longsword blow, while Seeker uses the Floating Disc Coin as an improvised barrier and the party continues battling the remaining undead.

location.context: southern cavern entrance and adjoining passage beneath the cistern
location.notes: The party fights from the narrow approach into the larger cavern.

npcs.name: Animated skeletons
npcs.context: three guardians in the southern cavern
npcs.notes: They descend from the ceiling and attack the party.

items.name: Floating Disc Coin
items.notes: Seeker maneuvers the disc between himself and the skeletons as cover.

mainEnemies.name: Animated skeletons
mainEnemies.notes: Three skeletons attack at the cavern entrance.

combat.notes: This beat begins the continuous cavern battle.

facts.shortSummary: An undead hobgoblin wielding an obsidian-topped staff joins the battle, but the party overwhelms it and captures the staff.
facts.longSummary: A rotting hobgoblin carrying a black iron staff crowned with pulsing obsidian enters the cavern, claims the power as its own, and repeatedly projects waves of rage and dark energy. The party finishes the remaining skeletons and turns on the new foe: Delwath curses it, Seeker and Wellby attack from range, and Kenzo closes in despite the staff's magical defenses. Wellby's hidden shot badly wounds it, and Kenzo finally strikes it down, leaving the still-radiating staff on the cavern floor.

location.notes: The second phase of the battle remains in the same cavern.

npcs.name: Undead hobgoblin staff-bearer
npcs.notes: It claims the staff's power, projects rage and darkness, and is killed by Kenzo.

npcs.name: Animated skeletons
npcs.notes: The party destroys the remaining skeletons as the staff-bearer joins the fight.

items.name: Black Iron Staff
items.notes: A magical staff topped by a sphere of black obsidian that radiates darkness and rage.

mainEnemies.name: Undead hobgoblin staff-bearer
mainEnemies.notes: The principal enemy in the second phase of the cavern battle.

mainEnemies.name: Animated skeletons
mainEnemies.notes: The remaining skeletons are destroyed during this phase.

combat.notes: The continuous cavern battle ends when Kenzo kills the staff-bearer.

facts.shortSummary: The party studies the malignant staff, connects it tentatively to Cha'mutte, and finds a flaw that may allow the obsidian to be destroyed.
facts.longSummary: Although its bearer is dead, the obsidian staff continues radiating rage, and its inscription speaks of binding others to an unnamed power. Searching the cavern reveals older petrified animals and a necklace whose winged-flame symbol Delwath associates with Cha'mutte's Great War armies. The party theorizes that the staff—not necessarily its undead wielder—drove the surrounding animals mad, while Seeker identifies a structural flaw in the obsidian. They debate moving it outside before Delwath warns that exposing it could spread its influence farther.

location.context: southern underground cavern and dead-end passage
location.notes: The party searches the battle site and examines the staff in place.

npcs.name: Undead hobgoblin staff-bearer
npcs.notes: The party searches its remains and finds a symbolic necklace.

npcs.name: Cha'mutte
npcs.context: possible origin of the staff and necklace symbol
npcs.notes: Delwath recognizes the symbol and theorizes that the staff may be a Great War weapon of Cha'mutte; the connection is not established as certain.

items.name: Black Iron Staff
items.notes: The staff remains magical and hostile after its bearer dies; Seeker finds a flaw in its obsidian sphere.

items.name: Cha'mutte symbol necklace
items.notes: A silver wing-and-flame necklace with a black pearl, tentatively identified by Delwath.

facts.shortSummary: The party shatters the obsidian, ends its maddening influence, and rests overnight before returning toward camp the next morning.
facts.longSummary: As agitated insects gather, the party commits to destroying the staff in the cavern. Kenzo uses Aagir's Everlight as a wedge against the flaw, suffering psychic backlash when his blow cracks the obsidian; Seeker's ordinary tools fail against its magical defenses, but Wellby widens the fracture despite further backlash. Delwath finally shatters it with a shadowy summoned blade, releasing the oppressive rage and calming the nearby animals. The party collects the now-mundane obsidian and necklace, plans to bring Arcus's petrified body into the temple, rests overnight, and finds the desert calmer when they head back toward camp on March 26.

location.context: destruction of the staff, retreat to the temple, overnight rest, and next-morning return toward camp
location.notes: The beat crosses midnight after the party rests in the pentagonal temple.

npcs.name: Arcus
npcs.notes: The party plans to carry his stone body up and shelter it in the temple during the rest.

items.name: Black Iron Staff
items.notes: Its obsidian sphere is shattered, ending the aura of rage.

items.name: Aagir's Everlight
items.notes: The enchanted silver spearpoint is used as a wedge against the flaw in the obsidian.

items.name: Obsidian shard
items.notes: Seeker collects a shard after the destroyed crystal becomes ordinary obsidian.

items.name: Cha'mutte symbol necklace
items.notes: The party takes the necklace for historical study after the staff is destroyed.

items.name: Floating Disc Coin
items.notes: The party designates the disc to move recovered objects and Arcus's petrified body.
